# Hide All Apps

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Hide's all apps that are currently open. Any apps provided in the except parameter, will not be hidden.

## Syntax

~~~~text
hideAllApps(except: <#AppArray#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
hideAllApps(except: [\)
~~~~
